actualPrimaryNorms.boundedOwnDecision: The actual norm separates tax legislative competences and gives Bundesrat consent for federal tax laws where revenue goes wholly or partly to Länder/municipalities. This supports the stipulated procedural distinction; receipts shares alone do not establish a municipal veto.

The actual norm allocates tax receipts and distinguishes joint taxes and municipal participation. The task explicitly labels 50/35/15 as fictional, so these are not reviewed as actual income-tax statutory shares.
The actual norm assigns Länder participation through Bundesrat in federal legislation/administration and EU matters. It does not grant an association or municipality an own Bundesrat vote.

The actual composition norm makes Bundesrat members members of Länder governments. This independently confirms the material’s limited Länder-government channel claim; no comprehensive procedure or constitutional-law assessment is claimed.
